email_subject: Application - Social Media Specialist at Stanley/Stella
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Social Media Specialist role at Stanley/Stella. Your mission to redefine responsible fashion resonates deeply, and I'm excited by the opportunity to drive paid social performance across European markets.

In my current role at Episto, I manage SEO and content for client websites, using data from Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Google Ads to guide decisions. I've also built and optimized mirook.com, implementing structured data and running technical audits to improve visibility. While my paid social experience is growing, I'm confident in my ability to quickly master Meta Ads and HubSpot, and I bring a commercial mindset and curiosity for AI-powered marketing.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and work fluently in English. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Social Media Specialist position at Stanley/Stella. Your commitment to premium, sustainable apparel and your entrepreneurial spirit align perfectly with my values and career aspirations. I am eager to contribute to your digital marketing efforts and help drive measurable business impact across European markets.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, content creation, and website builds for client sites. I use tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Google Ads to track performance and inform decisions. While my hands-on paid social experience is still developing, I have a strong foundation in data analysis and a proven ability to quickly learn new platforms. I am particularly drawn to this role's focus on Meta Ads and marketing automation, and I am confident I can rapidly become proficient in HubSpot and AI-powered marketing tools.

On my personal project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data, and ran technical SEO/GEO audits to improve search visibility. This experience honed my ability to adapt to new technologies and use data to drive results. I thrive in collaborative environments and am excited about the prospect of working closely with Communications, Sales, and local market teams to align campaigns with commercial goals.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and work fluently in English. I am passionate about sustainability and would be proud to contribute to Stanley/Stella's mission. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
